Introduction

TRCNG was a boy group under TS Entertainment. Their name stood for Teen Rising Champion in a New Generation. They originally debuted on October 10, 2017, with 10 members: Taeseon, Ji Hun, Ha Young, Hak Min, Woo Yeop, Ji Sung, Hyun Woo, Si Woo, Ho Hyeon, and Kang Min, releasing the song "Spectrum".

In November 2019, members Taeseon and Woo Yeop filed a lawsuit against TS Entertainment's director and head choreographer, accusing them of child abuse due to alleged physical violence. Following this, TRCNG promoted as an 8-member group.

On January 31, 2021, TS Entertainment reportedly shut down. Despite this, the group continued sharing content with fans through social media.

Finally, on March 28, 2022, TRCNG's contracts were officially terminated, and the group disbanded after a three-year hiatus.
